author: Simon's Cat
description:
Did you know, after a successful crowdfunding campaign in 2014, ‘Simon’s Cat: Off to the Vet' became the first 12-minute Simon's Cat film ever to be produced in full colour! Enjoy it all over again, now in 4k! 🍿  

After an unfortunate encounter in the garden, Simon’s Cat goes to great lengths to avoid an imminent visit to the vet. Will his long-suffering owner, Simon, step up to the challenge?
